availability: Only use values when their realtime_start date was reached, then end of that date in America/New_York plus one complete canonical XAU D1 interval. Never backfill first-created series into prior decisions.
purpose: Retrieve all four previously named ALFRED source archives via the verified public browser route; source validation only, not B predictor admission.
submission: One Download data click per series. Wait at most 60 seconds for the download event. Stop on rate limiting, authentication, CAPTCHA or other access gate; preserve any failed receipt. No urllib POST repetition.
transport: Codex in-app browser on Mac, native public download form. No API key, account creation or billing.
validation: ZIP CRC and byte hashes; exact source ID/units/format; all four CSV columns; parsed date bounds; finite numeric values or declared missing; ordered nonoverlapping real-time intervals per observation; no duplicate observation/start tuples; README vintages equal selected dates. Current open-ended intervals may have blank ends. Future revision end metadata is not a feature.
vintage_selection: All unique advertised form[selected_vintage_dates][] options within declared bounds, sorted chronologically; verify exact selected list equals that set before clicking. Bind returned README vintage dates and archive bytes.
